Read the walkthrough and the example results
  1. Start with a question. Loopset is a process and capacity simulator that runs in the browser.
  2. Choose from twelve editable templates. Service Studio, Festival Gate and Little Factory show staffing, arrivals and production in their original worlds.
  3. In the full walkthrough, an illustrated empty site receives shelves, a workbench and a pallet. The catalogue contains 1,141 browser-ready 3D models. Visual objects and numerical process behavior are separate.
  4. The actual Service Studio interface changes shared specialist availability from two units to three, then runs the model with Run & compare.
  5. In this synthetic one-hour example with 106 arrivals and seed 4207, completed requests rise from 66 to 86, average wait changes from 9.5 to 5.2 minutes, and modeled resource cost rises from $85 to $115. Station counts and the break calendar are unchanged. These are rounded outcomes from one example, not a business forecast.
  6. The full film illustrates saving and reusing a personal template. Loopset is free and open source, with no installation or account required. The films use music and interface effects, with no spoken narration.
